feedback_by_option.fil: Tama. Unahin ang sitwasyon at oras, saka ang tugon, paghinga at ginawa.
feedback_by_option.en: Correct. Start with the situation and the time, then the response, breathing and actions.

feedback_by_option.fil: Huwag magdagdag ng hinulaang diagnosis. Iulat ang nakita mo.
feedback_by_option.en: Do not add a guessed diagnosis. Report what you saw.

feedback_by_option.fil: Kailangan muna ng tatanggap ang agarang facts ayon sa ayos ng job aid, hindi ang buong kuwento.
feedback_by_option.en: The receiver needs the urgent facts first, in the job aid order, not the whole story.

feedback_by_option.fil: Huwag ibahagi ang detalye sa labas ng handover.
feedback_by_option.en: Do not share identifiable details outside the care handover.

feedback_by_option.fil: Hindi fact ang hula sa sanhi. Iulat lamang ang nakita at ginawa mo.
feedback_by_option.en: A guessed cause is not a fact. Report only what you saw and did.

feedback_by_option.fil: Tama. Tinatapos ang handover sa paghiling na kumpirmahin ng tatanggap ang susunod na hakbang.
feedback_by_option.en: Correct. Inviting the receiver to confirm the next action closes the handover.
